battle.name: 愛爾蘭獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 1919年1月在愛爾蘭爆發反英游擊戰，愛爾蘭共和軍在城鄉展開武裝對抗，旨在爭取脫離英國統治。

kit.name: 李-恩菲爾德 Mk III 步槍
kit.history: 該步槍是英國在第一次世界大戰中的主力栓式步槍，於愛爾蘭獨立戰爭期間被英軍與愛爾蘭武裝廣泛使用。

countries: 1919 年 1 月 21 日，愛爾蘭第一議會（First Dáil）在都柏林宣布成立愛爾蘭共和國，並拒絕承認英國對愛爾蘭的主權。英國政府則以 United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland 的官方名稱，透過陸軍部與皇家愛爾蘭警務處（Royal Irish Constabulary）維持對該島的軍警控制。此時英國本土的軍隊已從一次大戰的後備師抽調至愛爾蘭，並在 1919 年中期將兵力由約 20,000 人提升至 40,000 人，部署於都柏林、科克、米斯等主要城市及鐵路沿線。雙方的武裝衝突正式拉開序幕，英方以皇家陸軍與警務力量對抗愛爾蘭共和國軍（Irish Republican Army）的游擊隊伍，形成兩支國家級武裝力量的對抗局面。
countriesEn: On 21 January 1919, the First Dáil in Dublin proclaimed the Irish Republic and refused to acknowledge British sovereignty over Ireland. The British government, operating under the official name United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland, maintained control through the Army and the Royal Irish Constabulary (RIC). At this time the British home forces, drawn from reserve divisions after the Great War, were reinforcing Ireland, raising troop levels from roughly 20,000 in early 1919 to about 40,000 by mid‑year, concentrating in Dublin, Cork, Meath and along major rail lines. The armed conflict thus officially began, with the British side using the Royal Army and police forces against the Irish Republican Army’s guerrilla units, creating a state‑level confrontation between two national armed forces.
people: 在這場游擊戰中，邁克爾·柯林斯（Michael Collins）扮演了情報與組織的核心角色。1919 年 3 月，他被任命為愛爾蘭共和軍情報局局長，隨即建立了一個跨國的情報網絡，向都柏林的英國軍官滲透，並在同年 5 月策劃了對皇家愛爾蘭警務處情報員的暗殺行動。理查德·穆爾卡希（Richard Mulcahy）於 1919 年 6 月接任共和軍參謀長，負責協調各師的行動，制定統一的游擊戰術與後勤計畫。伊恩·馬克尼爾（Eoin MacNeill）在 1919 年 4 月被任命為國防部長，主持軍事立法與資源調配，並在 1920 年初組織了第一批「飛行縱隊」以快速打擊英軍前線。迪爾梅德·奧赫加蒂（Diarmuid O'Hegarty）負責議會文書與外交聯絡，確保國外的愛爾蘭僑民持續提供金援與武器。此 外，肖恩·馬克艾恩（Seán MacEoin）率領第 1 南師在 1920 年 5 月的基尔迈克尔（Kilmichael）伏擊中殲滅了英國增援部隊，展示了地方指揮官的獨立作戰能力。
peopleEn: During this guerrilla conflict Michael Collins served as the central figure for intelligence and organization. In March 1919 he was appointed Director of Intelligence of the Irish Republican Army, promptly building a trans‑national intelligence network that infiltrated British officers in Dublin and in May of the same year orchestrated the assassination of an RIC intelligence agent. Richard Mulcahy took over as Chief of Staff of the IRA in June 1919, coordinating divisional operations and formulating unified guerrilla tactics and logistics. Eoin MacNeill was appointed Minister for Defence in April 1919, overseeing military legislation, resource allocation, and in early 1920 organized the first “flying columns” for rapid strikes against British front lines. Diarmuid O’Hegarty handled Dáil correspondence and foreign liaison, ensuring continuous financial and arms support from the Irish diaspora abroad. Additionally, Seán MacEoin commanded the 1st Southern Division and, in the Kilmichael ambush of May 1920, destroyed a British reinforcement column, demonstrating the independent combat capability of local commanders.
kits: 雙方投入的武器與裝備反映了當時的技術水準與物資供應情況。愛爾蘭共和軍的主要步槍包括從美國與德國走私得來的 Ross M1903 步槍、Lee‑Enfield No.1 Mk.III .303 口徑步槍以及少量繳獲的德國 Mauser 1896 步槍；手槍方面則普遍使用 .455 Webley & Scott 左輪與少數 M1911 .45 口徑手槍，並配備自製的木柄手榴彈與簡易炸藥包以進行破壞行動。英國陸軍與皇家愛爾蘭警務處則裝備了 Lee‑Enfield Mk.V 步槍、Vickers .303 機槍、Hotchkiss M1909 輕機槍、3 英寸 Stokes 迫擊炮以及改裝的 Rolls‑Royce 裝甲車，後者在城鎮巡邏與鐵路護送任務中提供機動火力支援。雙方皆使用 8 mm 與 .303 兩種步槍彈藥，並依賴鐵路與小型卡車將彈藥從港口輸送至前線的臨時彈藥庫。
kitsEn: The weapons and equipment used by both sides reflected the technological level and supply situation of the era. The IRA’s primary rifles included Ross M1903 rifles, Lee‑Enfield No.1 Mk.III .303‑inch rifles smuggled from the United States and Germany, and a limited number of captured German Mauser 1896 rifles; sidearms were mainly .455 Webley & Scott revolvers and a few M1911 .45 pistols, supplemented by homemade wooden‑handled grenades and simple explosive charges for sabotage. The British Army and Royal Irish Constabulary were equipped with Lee‑Enfield Mk.V rifles, Vickers .303 machine guns, Hotchkiss M1909 light machine guns, 3‑inch Stokes mortars and converted Rolls‑Royce armoured cars, which provided mobile fire support for town patrols and railway escort duties. Both sides used 8 mm and .303 rifle ammunition, and relied on railways and small trucks to transport cartridges from ports to forward temporary ammunition depots.
tactics: 游擊戰術的核心在於以小股兵力實施快速打擊並迅速撤離，避免與英軍正面交火。愛爾蘭共和軍常採用道路伏擊、破壞鐵路與電報線路、以及針對警務站的小規模突襲。最著名的伏擊戰例是 1920 年 11 月 28 日在科克的「庫姆巴里尼」行動，志願兵在狹窄的山路上埋伏，使用步槍與手榴彈一次性摧毀英軍一個連的增援車隊，隨即在夜幕掩護下撤入森林。城市游擊則以「佔領」方式破壞為主，1921 年 5 月 25 日，志願兵在都柏林海關大樓（Custom House）放置大量炸藥，導致建築物嚴重受損，並藉此向外界展示其破壞能力。英國軍方則以「掃蕩」與「設防」相結合的策略回應，於主要城鎮設置臨時哨所，並使用裝甲車在公路上進行武裝巡邏，同時加強情報蒐集與情報網絡的滲透，試圖切斷共和軍的物資與通訊線路。
tacticsEn: The core of guerrilla tactics was to strike swiftly with small units and withdraw immediately, avoiding direct confrontations with British forces. The IRA commonly employed road ambushes, sabotage of railways and telegraph lines, and small‑scale raids on police stations. The most celebrated ambush took place on 28 November 1920 at “Cóbh” (Cooper’s Hill) near Cork, where volunteers concealed in a narrow mountain pass used rifles and grenades to wipe out an entire British reinforcement convoy before disappearing into the night. Urban guerrilla actions focused on destructive demonstrations; on 25 May 1921, IRA volunteers placed large explosive charges in Dublin’s Custom House, causing severe damage and projecting their destructive capability to the world. The British responded with a combined “sweep‑and‑hold” strategy, establishing temporary posts in key towns, using armoured cars for armed patrols on highways, and intensifying intelligence collection and infiltration to sever the republican supply and communication lines.
data: 以下為 1919 至 1921 年間關鍵軍事行動與後勤支援的時間序列，均有官方檔案與當時報導可查。1919 年 1 月 21 日，愛爾蘭共和軍在蒂珀雷裏郡的索爾黑德比格（Soloheadbeg）農場突襲皇家警務處巡邏隊，擊斃四名警員，此事件被視為戰爭的導火索。1919 年 4 月，首批從美國進口的步槍與彈藥抵達克里夫蘭港，隨即秘密轉運至都柏林與科克的地下軍械庫。1919 年 7 月，英國政府在都柏林增設第 6 武裝警察營，並在米斯郡建立臨時軍營，以加强对中部鐵路樞紐的控制。1920 年 5 月，共和軍第 1 南師在基尔迈克尔成功伏擊，殲滅英軍一個連，缴獲包括 20 支 Lee‑Enfield 步槍與 1,200 發子彈。1920 年 11 月，愛爾蘭裔社團透過加拿大魁北克的「芬蘭德」航運公司向英國境內走私了 3,000 發 8 mm 口徑彈藥，以補足前線的緊缺。1921 年 5 月 25 日，都柏林海關大樓被炸，導致英方損失約 50 萬英鎊的建築與設備。此 後，英國於 1921 年 7 月開始執行「軍官增援」計畫，向愛爾蘭增派第 17、18、19 步兵師，共計約 12,000 人，以試圖扭轉游擊劣勢。整體而言，1919‑1921 年間，雙方透過鐵路、公路與海上航線，共計調動了約 200 萬發步槍彈藥與 15,000 枚手榴彈，顯示出后勤補給在游裝戰中的重要性。
dataEn: The following chronological overview of key military operations and logistical support from 1919 to 1921 is based on official records and contemporary reports. On 21 January 1919, the IRA ambushed an RIC patrol at Soloheadbeg farm in County Tipperary, killing four constables, an event regarded as the war’s catalyst. In April 1919, the first shipment of rifles and ammunition imported from the United States arrived at Cleveland port, then covertly transferred to underground arsenals in Dublin and Cork. In July 1919, the British government established the 6th Armed Police Battalion in Dublin and set up a temporary camp in County Meath to strengthen control over the central railway hub. In May 1920, the IRA’s 1st Southern Division carried out the successful Kilmichael ambush, destroying a British company and capturing 20 Lee‑Enfield rifles together with 1,200 rounds of ammunition. In November 1920, the Irish‑American community shipped 3,000 rounds of 8 mm ammunition through the Finnish‑owned shipping line in Quebec to supplement front‑line shortages. On 25 May 1921, the Custom House in Dublin was bombed, causing the British an estimated loss of about £500,000 in buildings and equipment. Subsequently, in July 1921, Britain launched the “Officer Reinforcement” program, dispatching the 17th, 18th and 19th Infantry Divisions to Ireland, totalling roughly 12,000 troops, in an attempt to reverse the guerrilla disadvantage. Overall, between 1919 and 1921, both sides moved approximately two million rifle cartridges and 15,000 hand grenades via rail, road and sea routes, underscoring the critical role of logistics in guerrilla warfare.
cause: 戰爭的根本原因可追溯至一次大戰後愛爾蘭政治格局的失衡。1916 年的 Easter Rising 雖被鎮壓，但其所宣揚的共和理念在群眾中深植，1918 年的徵兵危機更激起大規模反英示威，導致大多數愛爾蘭選民在 1918 年的大選中支持新芬黨（Sinn Féin），並於 1919 年初召開第一屆愛爾蘭議會，宣佈獨立。英國政府則依舊堅持《1914 年政府法案》給予的有限自治，並拒絕承認議會的合法性，決定以武力維護其在愛爾蘭的行政與軍事控制。雙方在主權、稅收與兵役問題上的根本衝突，使得武裝對抗成為唯一的解決途徑。
causeEn: The root cause of the war stems from the political imbalance in Ireland after the First World War. Although the 1916 Easter Rising was suppressed, the republican ideals it espoused took deep root among the population; the 1918 conscription crisis sparked mass anti‑British protests, leading to a decisive Sinn Féin victory in the 1918 general election and the convening of the First Dáil in early 1919, which proclaimed independence. The British government, however, clung to the limited Home Rule offered by the 1914 Act, refused to recognize the Dáil’s legitimacy, and resolved to maintain its administrative and military control by force. The fundamental clash over sovereignty, taxation and conscription made armed conflict the only viable resolution.
impact: 這場衝突對愛爾蘭與英帝國的未來走向產生了深遠的影響。首先，戰爭的持續消耗迫使英國於 1921 年 12 月簽署《英愛條約》，承認愛爾蘭大部分地區的獨立，並創建愛爾蘭自由邦，然而條約亦保留了北愛爾蘭的六郡，形成日後的分割局面。其次，戰爭中磨練的游擊戰術與情報網絡，直接促成了 1922‑23 年的愛爾蘭內戰， former IRA 成員因對條約條款的分歧而武裝對抗，造成新國家內部的長期政治裂痕。再者，愛爾蘭游擊隊的成功鼓舞了全球範圍內的反殖民運動，譬如印度的國民志願軍與阿拉伯半島的民族起義皆參考了愛爾蘭的游擊作戰模式。最後，英國在愛爾蘭的軍事失敗加速了其帝國政策的收縮，促使其重新檢視在殖民地使用高強度軍事手段的成本與效益。
impactEn: The conflict had profound consequences for both Ireland and the British Empire. First, the sustained strain of the war forced Britain to sign the Anglo‑Irish Treaty in December 1921, granting independence to most of Ireland and establishing the Irish Free State, while retaining the six counties of Northern Ireland, thereby cementing partition. Second, the guerrilla tactics and intelligence networks honed during the war directly led to the Irish Civil War of 1922‑23, as former IRA members split over the treaty’s terms and took up arms against the new state, leaving a lasting political fissure. Third, the success of the Irish guerrillas inspired anti‑colonial movements worldwide; nationalist forces in India and the Arab peninsula studied and emulated the Irish guerrilla model. Finally, Britain’s military setback in Ireland accelerated a re‑evaluation of imperial policy, prompting a reassessment of the costs and benefits of using high‑intensity military force in its colonies.
result: 最終，愛爾蘭獨立戰爭以政治談判而非完全的軍事勝利告終。1921 年 12 月 6 日，雙方在倫敦簽署《英愛條約》，英國承認愛爾蘭自由邦的主權，並承諾於 1922 年 12 月前撤出大多數軍事與警務人員。條約同時規定北愛爾蘭有權選擇留在英國，促成愛爾蘭島的分割。根據條約，愛爾蘭議會於 1922 年 1 月召開，並於同年 12 月正式成立愛爾蘭自由邦，開始組建正規軍隊與警察部隊。英國軍隊在 1922 年底完成撤離，只在北愛爾蘭保留少量駐軍以維護當地的安全。此結果標誌著英帝國在歐洲的第一個主要殖民地的政治撤退，並為後續的的去殖民化潮流提供了重要的先例。
resultEn: In the end, the Irish War of Independence concluded with a political settlement rather than outright military victory. On 6 December 1921, both sides signed the Anglo‑Irish Treaty in London, whereby Britain recognised the sovereignty of the Irish Free State and pledged to withdraw the bulk of its military and police forces by December 1922. The treaty also allowed Northern Ireland the option to remain within the United Kingdom, sealing the partition of the island. In accordance with the agreement, the Dáil convened in January 1922 and formally established the Irish Free State in December of that year, proceeding to create a regular army and police force. British troops completed their withdrawal by the end of 1922, retaining only a small garrison in Northern Ireland to safeguard its security. This outcome marked the first major political retreat of the British Empire in Europe and set a significant precedent for subsequent decolonisation movements.
